caption: Class means from the worked example are m₁ = (2, 2.67) and m₂ = (6, 4.67); the test point x = (4, 3) is 2.03 from m₁ and 2.60 from m₂, so it lies on the ω₁ side of the perpendicular bisector and the rule labels it ω₁. With equal priors and equal isotropic covariance σ²I this same line is the Bayes boundary.

spec.aria: Two class means in a two-dimensional feature space, a test point closer to the first mean, and the straight perpendicular bisector of the segment joining the means separating the two sides.
